Definition: an angle (as projecting), i.e. (by implication) a corner-column (or anta)
BiblicalUsage: Zaviyth is a corner, the angle where two walls meet and the strength of a building is tested. The Psalmist prays that Israel's daughters will be like polished corner stones, and Zechariah pictures God's people filling the corners of the altar like bowls.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that corners matter more than we think, because a house stands or falls where its walls join.
